explanation.headline: Carbamazepine is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to a registered plant last inspected VAI 2024-03-29

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include carbamazepine as of 2026-10-21.
The product used at both Corvale sites carries NDC 72603088701 and is labeled by Northstar Rx LLC with a registered manufacturing plant at Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) in India.
FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2024-03-29 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-05-13.
Earlier inspections of the same plant in 2015-10-09 and 2019-07-05 were also classified VAI.
Corvale East holds 70 tablets (9.2 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 153 tablets (19.9 days on hand) of the 200 mg extended-release tablet.
The recommended action is to transfer 37 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave the sender with 15 days and bring the receiver to 14 days of supply.
